name: ea-flood-sdk-evaluation
description: Voxgig-generated TypeScript SDK evaluation for Environment Agency station listing and lookup

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix sdk/.sdk && npm ci --prefix sdk/ts
scripts.generate: node scripts/sync-spec.cjs && npm run generate --prefix sdk/.sdk
scripts.test:types: node sdk/ts/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --strict --noEmit --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --typeRoots sdk/ts/node_modules/@types test/consumer-types.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:spec && npm run test:generated && npm run test:contract && npm run test:types
scripts.verify: npm run generate && npm test && npm run doctor && npm run test:regeneration
